\n\n"; let startAt=0, active=false, timer=null; const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='gambitLoginIntro';overlay.setAttribute('aria-label','กำลังเข้าสู่ระบบ GAMBIT');overlay.setAttribute('role','status'); const frame=document.createElement('iframe');frame.title='GAMBIT Luxury Loading';frame.setAttribute('sandbox','allow-scripts');overlay.appendChild(frame); document.body.appendChild(overlay); function stop(){active=false;clearTimeout(timer);overlay.classList.add('is-leaving');timer=setTimeout(()=>{overlay.classList.remove('is-visible','is-leaving');overlay.style.display='none';frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc')},580)} window.gambitLoginIntro={ start(){clearTimeout(timer);active=true;startAt=Date.now();frame.srcdoc=demoHTML;overlay.style.display='flex';overlay.classList.remove('is-leaving');requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add('is-visible'))}, async finish(){if(!active)return;const remaining=Math.max(0,6200-(Date.now()-startAt));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,remaining));stop();await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,580))}, stop }; })();
